about_the_game:
It's been so long since the sun's been here... But even in the dread of eternal night, storm of spite, in gloom forlorn, friendships are born. Or... something more?

Adapted from the award-winning VR experience of the same name, Gloomy Eyes is set in a dark world shaken by the conflict between the living and the dead, and tells a peculiar story about love and differences.

You play alternately as Gloomy, a mysterious zombie child, and Nena, a human girl. The two quickly fall for each other despite Nena’s uncle being the leader of the zombie hunters, and depart on a quest to bring warmth back to their forsaken lands. Using Gloomy and Nena’s unique abilities, solve smart puzzles and help them on their quest to find The Sun and make it rise again.

An intense emotional bond

Gloomy Eyes tells a poignant tale of tenderness, drawing players into the journey of two atypical lovers trying to bring light back to the world, despite fear, conflict, and hostility.

A unique art style

Navigate beautiful dioramas carefully crafted with a unique, breathtaking art direction inherited from the acclaimed virtual reality experience that won the best VR movie award at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in 2019.

FEATURES

  • Play alternately as Nena and Gloomy, each one with unique skills

  • A dark fantasy world

  • Creative and smart puzzles

  • A tender tale about loneliness, differences, and love

  • Bewitching soundtrack and visuals

short_description: The sun has left this world. The darkness raised the dead from their eternal slumber, and an oppressive leader has since cast them out. Play as Gloomy and Nena, a zombie and a human on a quest to find The Sun in this dark but poetic narrative puzzle game.
